title: AdvancedIF: Rubric-Based Benchmarking and Reinforcement Learning for Advancing LLM Instruction Following
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating and training LLMs for complex instruction following using rubrics. While it includes 'safety' as one of several categories for testing system prompt steerability (aimed at preventing adversarial attacks), it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, morals, or ethics as a primary component.
